caption: Held-out R² at layer 19 for predicting instruct answers. Blue: each model's own context->answer map (instruct ceiling 0.673, base 0.588). Orange: the base map run through a fitted general-linear base->instruct change-of-coordinates (A_ans o M_base o A_ctx^-1), scored on instruct answers — it reaches the instruct ceiling (0.673), i.e. post-training re-expresses the same map in different coordinates. (Rotation-restricted variants recorded in `values` but not plotted: scaled rotation 0.559, pure rotation -0.364.)
